summary: A former working fire lookout north of Smithers, upgraded around 2010 into a winter cabin that the Bulkley Backcountry Ski Society books for a fee.

facts.design: Two-story cubical cab with an upstairs room glazed on all sides

access.note: Booked through the Bulkley Backcountry Ski Society; the Rainlander says it is rented for a fee.

visit.trail_note: Steep trail, well-marked with orange reflectors and tape; about 75 minutes from the parking area. The access road has potholes and may need more than a low-clearance car.

events.note: Upgraded from a working fire lookout into a winter-ready cabin; the source dates this to around 2010.

notes_for_editor: No original build date or working-lookout years found in the pages read; the 2010 upgrade date rests on one homestead blog (Wild Bluebell) and is given as 'around 2010'. Record kind 'ground' conflicts with the two-story description; correction proposed for human review. Record location (54.88007, -127.56914) not checked. Wild Bluebell says the cabin is maintained in partnership with Recreation Sites and Trails BC, but no source names the land manager, so no agency is recorded. No photos captured.
